observations: Steal An Egg (77 days) still leads Most Popular ahead of evergreens Brookhaven, Murder Mystery 2, 99 Nights in the Forest and RIVALS, with the 265-day +1 Speed Keyboard Escape holding its top-six spot.
Today's snapshot flags every chart as partial (public lists only), so no new presence day was counted and position-based confidences barely moved; the four recorded days are still the evidence base.

Games past a year keep the best median pillar percentile (62) and 15-42 day games sit at 60, while 43-84 day (31) and 85-122 day (12) games sit low, which keeps the mid-life trough idea (H-mp-009, 35%) speculative but alive.
The weakest holders are young simulator templates (Race for Eggs, Build the Pyramid!, Kick a Lucky Block) and the 86-day Anime Zero, all updated today.
patterns: Passes priced above 149 Robux (H-mp-001, 63%) and dev products above 79 Robux (H-mp-011, 64%) tend to go with higher and longer presence; studio maturity and game age are likely confounders for both.
Bigger servers tend to go with higher positions (H-mp-007, now 64%), and solo loops tend to sit lower (H-mp-003, 60%); both strengthened slightly with today's extra profiles.
Games selling a generic 2x pass sit lower (r = -0.31, 54 of 99 games), a new tested idea; it may simply mark the simulator-template genre rather than the pass itself.
Among profiled games, combat PvP (78) and roleplay (69) loops hold the best median percentiles while collect-upgrade-rebirth (14), story adventure (18) and hatch-pets (20) sit lowest.

outliers.name: Steal An Egg
outliers.note: A 77-day template game at #1 against the evergreen pattern; its reach is clear but whether it outlasts the mid-life trough is the open question.

outliers.name: RIVALS
outliers.note: An all-caps title near the top, the main counterexample to H-mp-002; its duel-shooter economy and strong brand outweigh the title style.

outliers.name: Anime Zero [SHADOW MONARCH]
outliers.note: Among the weakest Most Popular holders yet one of the best Top Trending climbers, a young RPG still building toward sustained presence.

observations: Donation and social-spending games again top efficiency (Donation Central, Summer Donations, Simple DONATIONS), joined by evil plate game, Korea Army and Strikeborn.
The 15-42 day band has by far the weakest median efficiency (18) against 57 for games past a year, matching H-te-001 (69%) that revenue per player rises after week six.
The weakest monetizers are all young breakouts updated today: Peel THE Potato, Firefighting Sim, 7 Days Cat-Sitting and Makeup Mania.
Today's chart is the public list only (477 games), so efficiency ranks for small games carry the usual single-snapshot noise noted in H-te-019.
patterns: Most tested Top Earning ideas sit near the 69% ceiling set by five recorded days: higher dev-product prices, bracket tags, codes, 25+ player servers, RPG genre, complexity and longer descriptions consistently go with better efficiency in direction, but more days are needed before any can be called consistent.
Combat PvP is now the largest profiled loop on Top Earning (32 games, median percentile 60) and correlates positively with efficiency (r = +0.30); a new tested hypothesis tracks it.
Pet/egg, '+1', anime and steal titles sit low on efficiency (Egg r = -0.55, Steal -0.38, +1 -0.32), consistent with H-x-002.
Tower defense (4 games, median 91) and story adventure (67) loops rank high on efficiency in small samples, which may point to depth-driven spending.

outliers.name: Strikeborn [EARLY ACCESS]
outliers.note: Among the most efficient earners with zero passes and a stale update (26 days), likely an early-access paid-entry or low-CCU effect.

outliers.name: Firefighting Sim
outliers.note: A counterexample to the dev-product price, premium pass and recency ideas; at 18 days its revenue simply hasn't caught up with players.

observations: With today's Top Trending list flagged partial, momentum still rests on yesterday's verified movement: COCARDO: LA HELADERIA, Hide In Pixels and Lift Rock For Eggs lead, followed by Shoot For Eggs and Climb For Animals Eggs.
The 0-14 day band keeps a median momentum percentile of 96 versus about 45 for 15-84 day games.
Steal and tower templates (Steal A Car, TROLL Wheelchair Tower) and party formats (I Can Read Your Mind) are among the weakest climbers.
Hatch-collect-pets loops hold the best median momentum among profiled loops (93), party minigames the worst (13).
patterns: Plain gameplay-screenshot thumbnails go with weaker momentum (r = -0.38, within-age -0.59), the mirror of the reward-flex idea (H-tt-006, 55%); a new tested hypothesis tracks it.
PvP loops tend to climb more slowly (H-tt-011, 58%), and competitive-core games show the same direction (r = -0.44), while selling currency packs tends to go with higher positions (H-tt-010, 57%).
Egg titles go with higher positions (keyword r = +0.36, pets/eggs mechanic +0.39 within age), the strongest gameplay signal on this chart.
Shorter descriptions tend to go with higher positions (H-tt-003, 59%), the opposite of Top Earning, consistent with simple templates breaking out and deeper games monetizing.

outliers.name: Anime Zero [SHADOW MONARCH]
outliers.note: At 86 days it climbs like a two-week game, the main counterexample to H-tt-001, likely because a fresh content update reset its momentum.

outliers.name: [🎨] Hide In Pixels
outliers.note: A party format with a 60% like ratio among the best climbers, against H-tt-004 and the general weakness of party loops.

observations: Get Your Driver's License! (11 days, 27% likes) still leads, ahead of Huss Valley, Sarab, Sell Fries! [Anomaly], Break and Steal an Egg and COCARDO.

Today's profiling covered the lower half of the chart: duel shooters (Archer, ONE TAP PISTOLS), a territory-conquest port (RoFront), a troll-actions idle game (Next Subject, 29% likes) and several steal/egg variants.
Egg titles make up 20% of the chart and steal titles 11%, but steal-a-X loops sit in the lower half (median percentile 34).
The weakest holders are Create Pottery!, 2 Player Pizza Tycoon, MM2 of The Locust and Open Sea For Animals!.
patterns: Recently updated games (H-uc-012, 60%) and character-art thumbnails (H-uc-011, 60%) tend to rank higher among games of the same age.
Games pitched as co-op with friends rank lower (r = -0.45 within age, 12 games), which cuts against the solo-versus-social idea (H-uc-007, now 52%); a new tested hypothesis separates the two.
Everyday job simulations tend to rank high (H-uc-009, 59%) and horror-escape loops hold a median of 87, while '+1' incrementals (31) and steal bases (34) sit low.
Like ratio shows no reliable link to position (H-uc-006, 44%), with the two lowest-rated games (27% and 29%) on the chart's upper half.

outliers.name: Get Your Driver's License!
outliers.note: Leads with a 27% like ratio, likely curiosity and meme traffic outrunning player satisfaction.

outliers.name: Open Sea For Animals!
outliers.note: A well-liked (97%) pet/egg game near the bottom, a counterexample to H-uc-001, probably crowded out by the many egg clones.

summary: Every chart in today's snapshot came from the public lists and is flagged partial, so day-based tests did not advance; today's movement in confidence comes from 60 new gameplay profiles (296 games profiled in total).

The popularity-versus-revenue split held: egg, steal and '+1' templates drive Up-and-Coming and Top Trending entries but sit low on Top Earning efficiency, while RPGs, combat PvP and donation hubs earn most per player.

Combat PvP looks like the clearest split loop: it holds the best Most Popular percentile (78) and positive Top Earning efficiency but tends to climb Top Trending slowly, consistent with H-x-003 (pull later, monetize longer).
Description length points opposite ways on Top Earning (+0.23) and Top Trending (-0.28), likely a game-age confounder: older deeper games write more and earn more per player.
progressions: Up-and-Coming to Top Trending remains the most common path (17 games, median 2 days later), then Top Earning to Top Trending (11, 3 days).
Top Trending to Most Popular stays the main entry route into Most Popular (10 games, 2 days), ahead of Up-and-Coming to Most Popular (5, 1 day).
No new progressions were counted today because the snapshot's lists are flagged partial.
